description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it and Blasting Station triggers.
Resolve the Flayer of the Hatebound trigger, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it,.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from step 1 and 6.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
